pulls.title: 8391830: javac incorrectly considers types disjoint in instanceof when symbols are incomplete
pulls.author: lahodaj
pulls.body_excerpt: When casting one type to another, javac checks whether the two types (source and target) are "disjoint". To check this, it needs to know whether the types are interfaces or classes - because for classes, the class hierarchy can be checked to gain a more strict result than for (unsealed) interfaces. But, currently, `Symbol.isInterface` is not forcing a complete, so it may falsely return `false`, creating an impression the given type is a class, leading to a wrong "disjoint types" error. This problem has been introduced recently here: https://github.com/lahodaj/jdk/blame/cc278dbb8a1ca0754d584270
